lines.text: سیار هدیه روح منور و قالب معطر سلطان سریر رسالت و صاحب قران جهان
lines.en: A wandering gift to the illuminated spirit and perfumed body of the Sultan of the throne of prophethood and the Lord of the Conjunction of the world,

lines.text: جلالت قطب معدل مسیر دایره شریعت و مثوت نقطه محاذات خط استوای
lines.en: the majesty of the pole of the equator of the path of the circle of the Sharia and the resting place of the point of alignment of the equator of

lines.text: عالم حقیقت و طریقت ماه فلک مستقیم کرم وجود مهر سپهر ظهور نور وجود
lines.en: the world of truth and the path, the moon of the straight heaven of the generosity of existence, the sun of the sphere of the manifestation of the light of existence,

lines.text: آفتاب روشن تاب والضحی نجم انجمن افروز و النجم اذا هوی مسافر سورستان
lines.en: the bright shining sun of 'By the morning hours', the star that illuminates the assembly of 'By the star when it goes down', the traveler of the festive land of

lines.text: الذی اسری محرم حرم فکان قاب قوسین او ادنی بیت انخواجه که شد فلک غلامش
lines.en: 'Who took His servant for a journey by night', the confidant of the sanctuary of 'And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer'. Verse: That master whose slave the heaven became,

lines.text: از شش عرش گشت نامش المحرم سرد و الجلالی خورشید سپهر لایزالی مهری
lines.en: from the six [directions] of the throne his name became 'The confidant of the cold and the majestic', the sun of the eternal sphere, a sun

lines.text: که نبود سایه او را عرشست کمینه پایه او را بر فرق نهم فلک قدم زد بر ذروه
lines.en: that had no shadow, the Throne is his lowest step. He set foot on the crown of the ninth heaven, on the zenith of

lines.text: لامکان علم زد والشمس حکایتی ز رویش واللیل کنایتی زمویش مقصود
lines.en: the placeless he raised his banner, 'And the sun' is a tale of his face, 'And the night' is an allusion to his hair, the purpose of

lines.text: زمین و اسمان اوست پیغمبر اخرالزمان اوست دین کشته ز دولتش مخلد ختم
lines.en: the earth and the sky is he, the prophet of the end of time is he, religion became eternal through his fortune, the seal of

lines.text: همه انبیا محمد صلی الله علیه و آله الاتقیا سیما کاشف مضمون لو کشف الغطا
lines.en: all prophets is Muhammad, may God bless him and his pious family, especially the discoverer of the content of 'If the veil were removed',

lines.text: و صاحب مدلول انا مدینة العلم وعلی بابها و المخصوص بنص انما و المخصوص
lines.en: and the possessor of the meaning of 'I am the city of knowledge and Ali is its gate', and the one specified by the text of 'Only', and the one specified

lines.text: بحدیث منی بمنزله هرون من موسی اعنی علی المرتضی و اولاده الاخیار و عترته
lines.en: by the hadith 'You are to me in the position of Aaron to Moses', I mean Ali al-Murtada and his chosen children and his family

lines.text: الابرار التی اذهب عنهم الرجس و طهرهم تطهیرا بعد بر ارباب فهم و فطرت و
lines.en: the righteous, from whom God removed impurity and purified them with a thorough purification. Afterwards, to the masters of understanding and nature and

lines.text: اصحاب ذکا و فطنت محجوب و مستور نماند که علم هیئت که مر اینه مشتمل بر معرفت اوضاع
lines.en: the companions of intelligence and sagacity, let it not remain hidden and concealed that the science of astronomy, which is a mirror containing the knowledge of the positions of

lines.text: اجرام علوی و محتویست بر حقیقت احوال اجسام سفلی از جمله اشرف علوم حقیقیه
lines.en: the celestial bodies and contains the truth of the conditions of the terrestrial bodies, is among the noblest of the true sciences

lines.text: و اکمل صنایع حکمیه است و عالم این علم شریف و ناظر اینفن لطیف در زمره الذین
lines.en: and the most perfect of the philosophical arts, and the scholar of this noble science and the observer of this subtle art is in the group of 'Those who

lines.text: یذکرون الله قیاما و قعودا و علی جنوبهم و یتفکرون فی خلق السموات و الارض
lines.en: remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying down on their sides, and contemplate the (wonders of) creation in the heavens and the earth'

lines.text: داخل و لاحق لهذا اکثر علمای نامدار و اغلب فضلای عالیمقدار این صنعت
lines.en: is included and joined. For this reason, most of the renowned scholars and the majority of the highly esteemed learned men have considered this art

lines.text: رفیع المنزله را بمرقاه معارج سموات علا و منهاج مدارک او عوالی الله فیها
lines.en: of high rank as a ladder to the ascents of the high heavens and a path to the perceptions of the heights of God in them

sections.en: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

summary.headline: Dedication and Praise of Astronomy
summary.text: Panegyric dedication to Muhammad, Ali al-Murtada, and their purified family, followed by praise of astronomy as a noble philosophical science revealing celestial positions and terrestrial conditions.
